sections.title: About Us

columns.title: About Us content
columns.content:
About Us

The foundation of DPS Eldeco was laid down in the year 2000. The
school has grown leaps and bounds since its inception. The journey
that began with imparting education till class V is now offering PCM,
PCB, Commerce and Humanities in standard XII. The school is constantly
evolving and broadening its approach to provide a holistic learning
environment to the students.The school is affiliated to the Central
Board of Secondary Education. We are striving to keep up with the board’s
vision of imbibing the values conceived in the NEP 2020. Along with the
co-scholastic activities the students are offered Skill Subjects and
Optional subjects for multidimensional growth. Besides scholastic we
also emphasize on the performing arts through adequate dance, music
and singing lessons in the curriculum. The health and fitness of the
students is paramount for us. Thus we offer various sports like swimming,
badminton, tennis, cricket and many more. A healthy body fosters a healthy
mind, empowering students to excel and achieve laurels in academics. Our
school’s motto, Service before Self, is a constant reminder that the safety
and well being of fellow human beings comes before our own welfare, comfort
and security.

Fill out the form above to kickstart the DPS admission process!

items.title: Parents of Andrie Tiwari
items.description:
We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to the school and the entire teaching faculty for their continuous support, guidance, and encouragement throughout our child’s academic journey. The dedication, hard work, and personal attention given by the teachers have played a significant role in shaping not only our daughter's academic success but also her overall growth and confidence. This would not have been possible without the inspiring environment, mentorship, and motivation provided by the school and its teachers.

Parents of Andrie Tiwari

items.title: Parents of Sreebhadra Damodaran
items.description:
We extend our heartfelt gratitude to Delhi Public School, Eldeco for their unwavering commitment to academic excellence. Our daughter’s outstanding board results are a testament to the school’s dedicated faculty, structured curriculum, and supportive learning environment. We deeply appreciate the school’s role in shaping her success.
Parents of Sreebhadra Damodaran

items.title: Parents of Sarthak Awasthi
items.description:
We are proud that our son Sarthak excelled in the Grade 10 th board exams. He did well due to his hard work , perseverance, commitment and quest for knowledge. It was not possible without the guidance of his teachers that enabled him to remain focussed throughout the year. We are very exhilarated for his accomplishments and wish him more success in future. Congratulations to the school !
Parents of Sarthak Awasthi

items.title: Parents of Ahmad Shayan
items.description:
We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to the Principal ma’am and teachers of Delhi Public School Eldeco. Their collective efforts and unwavering support is the spark a child needs to perform to their caliber and shine bright. Most appreciably, not only do they impart quality education, but also they support the children by understanding their goals, and channeling their efforts to the needs of each student.
Parents of Ahmad Shayan
